requirements.accept: Upgrade a verified populated v8 to v9 additively; preserve every old row, migration hash, issued payload, correction edge and named native graph. Repeat and failed upgrades have explicit atomic outcomes.
Reuse existing same-assessment correction branches without relabeling them as selections or independent support. Plain issuance does not imply correction or selection.

Selection requires a known assessment identity, explicit application decision context and integer as-of sequence. Select one issued assessment version as a whole bundle, retaining all its owned result versions and exact context/method/basis/scale/dimension/time pins.

Append documentary SELECT, WITHDRAW and CLEAR decisions. A context withdrawal of an exact version is sticky in that context; no reselect or reinstatement of that version. An explicit selection of a different non-withdrawn version is allowed. CLEAR removes the selected pointer and preserves every withdrawal notice and prior answer.

Keep endpoint sources and declaration provenance separate. Require actor attribution, reason, source record, locator, interpretation origin and canonical recorded UTC. Database-assigned order determines as-of state; attribution is not verified authority.

Preserve UNKNOWN/null and conflicting result rows. Selection alone does not make a task ready, compute a score or authorize comparison. No result, source or interpretation pin may leak from another assessment version or application decision context.

Validate exact schema/ledger/configuration and existing data; enforce required references and immutable events through SQL and API. Execute caller-owned rollback, backup/reopen and logical dump/restore; reject tampering and old exact-schema readers.

Keep every selected native graph unchanged and separate. All new lifecycle decisions are application metadata, with no new native class or predicate and no automatic occurrence, mandate, truth or corroboration.

Bind every fixed control to requirements, setup, literal expected answer and a separate actual execution receipt. Preserve all 306 native dispositions, 236 deferred elements, eleven WITHHELD admissions and zero independent ratings unless a separately justified reviewed scope changes them.

Publish a complete schema/key/index rationale and executable example with understandable expected answers. Review the researcher/reviewer, domain and integrator reading paths; bind current channels and exact release components after implementation, without rewriting earlier snapshots.

derived_task_questions.question: Which whole assessment bundle was explicitly selected in this decision context at this ledger boundary?
Can the original and every declared correction remain retrievable after selection, withdrawal and clear?

event_shape.target: Exact issued assessment version for SELECT/WITHDRAW; NULL for CLEAR.
event_shape.sequence: Positive database-assigned monotonic order. Callers cannot supply it; audit/restore verify order and state transitions.

query_contract.as_of: Integer 0..current durable ledger head, excluding bool; 0 denotes before all decisions.
query_contract.output: state, selected assessment version or null, exact owned result bundle, decision provenance and ledger boundary; no scalar value chosen from conflicting results.
query_contract.missing: Unknown assessment is an error; a known assessment with no context decision is NO_SELECTION.
query_contract.ordering: Use only database event sequence, never timestamp, display label, issue order or correction depth.

ownership.native: Existing RKM-C032 assessment and RKM-C034 result/version/pin mappings only.
ownership.supplementary: Decision context, actor attribution and SELECT/WITHDRAW/CLEAR ledger.
ownership.result_policy: No independent result selection or correction edge is introduced; all returned results belong to the selected assessment version.

reader_acceptance.criterion: The opening example explains the user task before identifiers, checksums or process gates.
A reviewer can follow requirement, selected version, source, expected answer and actual result without combining incompatible dated evidence.
A domain reader can distinguish correction, selection, withdrawal, unknown and competing results in plain technical English.
An integrator gets prerequisites, bound example commands and exact expected answers for two contexts and historical retrieval.
The text separates decision context from native assessment context and explains what selection establishes.
Tables and links remain readable; current source, model, SQL, documentation and paper versions have explicit roles.

release_integration_requirement: Before main integration, explicitly version the development/publication boundary. The current v0.3.5 reader publisher intentionally rejects non-documentation changes. Preserve all 687 selected hashes, four snapshots and current published reader source; do not broaden its allowlist silently or relabel prospective files as executed components.
